_comment: Illustrative numbers in a plausible adult range, not a measurement of anyone. Torque = force x lever arm (joint centre to dynamometer pad); give torque_Nm, or force_N and lever_arm_m. posture_deg overrides the action's default test posture (configs/strength_actions.json).
protocol: make test, best of 3 maximal isometric contractions, 3 s each
